adjudication.rationale: Looking at packages/lib/CalendarService.ts lines 153-163, the code extracts only the first destination calendar with `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` and then filters calendars to only match that single externalId: `.filter((c) => mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId ? c.externalId === mainHostDestinationCalendar.externalId : true)`. This means for collective team events where multiple hosts have destination calendars (as shown in handleNewBooking.ts where teamDestinationCalendars are pushed to evt.destinationCalendar), only the first host's calendar will have events created. The CalDAV/BaseCalendarService implementation doesn't iterate through all destination calendars like GoogleCalendarService does with its credentialId matching logic.
